row_basis_not_a_reopen.what: G035 corrected_verdict: sharing the ROW space WINS 6.3% on adjacent gate at ~1.03 bits/elem (0.57592 vs 0.61465), 9× more than the far pair.
row_basis_not_a_reopen.why_not_design_around_it: The win is at the DEAD zone: pair errors 0.58–0.70 against the coherent anchor 0.198. G034 independently measured low-rank at a usable 3.25 bits/elem running 2.93× worse than flat q3. Whether the row-basis edge survives at usable fidelity is UNTESTED and is a low-rank-family question G034 already closed. Designing a native row-basis kernel around a dead-zone 6% would be designing around a fidelity result.

decision.hadamard_not_a_reopen: Block-diagonal Sylvester-Hadamard is generated, not stored. At q4 it moves hold cosine by +3.4e-4 and entropy by +0.026 bits. That is not a shared-basis win and not a bits-at-equal-function win. Folding H into a native operator is the structured_transform family, already PARTIAL, already measured.

g035.obligation: G035 -- shared basis plus per-layer coefficients vs independent, matched bits
g035.method: Randomized-SVD range finder; only the leading subspace is compared, an exact SVD of a 17408x10240 matrix is neither affordable nor needed. Independent gives each layer its own rank-r factorization; shared computes one column basis from the two layers concatenated and projects both onto it. The shared basis IS the alignment and it is inside the parameter budget, so there is no separate alignment cost to omit.
g035.error_space: FUNCTION space on the thick v2 capture, not weight cosine -- weight space already inverted a ranking once in this campaign (G033).
g035.corrected_verdict: AXIS-DEPENDENT, which the original refutation did not distinguish. Sharing the COLUMN space (the contraction axis) LOSES on 3/3 pairs. Sharing the ROW space (the output axis) WINS, and wins 9x more for adjacent layers than distant ones. The blanket 'REFUTED AT MATCHED BITS' was drawn from the column basis alone and is too broad.
g035.what_still_limits_it: The row-basis win is measured at ~1.03 bits/elem where the pair errors are 0.58-0.70, deep in the DEAD zone against the coherent anchor's 0.198. It is a 6.3% improvement to something unusable. G034 separately measured low-rank at a usable 3.25 bits/elem running 2.93x worse than flat q3, so the family's ceiling is low whichever axis is shared. Whether the row-basis advantage survives at usable fidelity is UNTESTED.
g035.row_basis_verdict: WINS, unlike the column basis. Adjacent gate_proj L30/L31: 0.57592 against independent 0.61465, a 6.3% error reduction at slightly FEWER bits. Far pair L15/L47: 0.69274 against 0.69775, only 0.7%. THE ADJACENCY SIGNATURE THE COLUMN BASIS FAILED TO SHOW IS PRESENT HERE -- adjacent benefits 9x more than distant, which is what the spectral observation that opened this obligation predicted.
g035.delta_coding_verdict: REFUTED, and not marginally: roughly 2x the error of independent q3+q3 at identical total bits on all three pairs and in BOTH directions. The delta carries L_a's quantization error on top of the genuine layer difference, so it has a WIDER spread than the tensor it replaces and quantizes worse at q2 than the tensor does at q3. The far pair behaves like the adjacent pair, so proximity does not help.

g034.verdict: REFUTED at the coherent operating point: at identical bits the low-rank operator is 2.93x the output error of flat q3 on every tensor tested. It reduces operations to 0.203x dense, but the acceptance requires bytes AND operations WITH function preserved.
g034.family_verdict: COMPREHENSIVELY REFUTED at the coherent operating point. Plain low-rank is 2.93x flat q3's error at identical bits; TT unfolding is worse again. The acceptance also requires a native kernel path and none was built, but no member has earned one.

math.W_ell: R^{m×n}, x in R^n, y in R^m
math.column_basis_share_the_one_that_lost: For a pair (W_a, W_b), stack S = [W_a W_b] in R^{m×2n}. Randomized SVD gives U in R^{m×r} spanning the column space of S. C_ell = U^T W_ell in R^{r×n}. Ŵ_ell = U C_ell.
math.native_production_algebra: z = C_ell x  in R^r;  y = U z  in R^m.  Never form Ŵ_ell. This is the same y as (U C_ell) x by associativity.
math.row_basis_share_dead_zone_win: Stack along rows, share V in R^{n×r}, Ŵ_ell = A_ell V^T. Native: z = V^T x; y = A_ell z. Measured +6.3% adjacent at ~1.03 b/elem, unusable vs coherent 0.198. Not a reopen.

correctness_oracle.definition: Form Ŵ_ell = U C_ell as an m×n f32 matrix in DRAM (or on host). y_oracle = Ŵ_ell x. Compare y_native to y_oracle. This path exists to prove algebraic correctness. It is NOT a production implementation and must never be presented as one. On the incumbent, the analogous trap is qwen_uniform_q4_decode_vector (102.5e9 B/token of dense W); qwen38_hybrid_decode.rs does not dispatch it.
correctness_oracle.tolerance: max_abs(y_native - y_oracle) consistent with f32 GEMV rounding

That is a hardware constraint, not a coding preference.

register_pressure.incumbent_tpr64: 64 threads/row, 8 Q4 weights unpacked per iteration into registers, FMA, discard. Occupancy: 17408-row gate → 8704 TGs of 128 = 1,114,112 threads; 145 TGs/core if spread. Bandwidth-saturated, not occupancy-starved (NOETIC_TPR64_REOPEN simd_vehicle).
register_pressure.two_stage_sequential: Stage-1 is a fat GEMV of only r=417 rows (gate) — under-occupied relative to 17408-row q4. Stage-2 GEMV of 17408 rows against a 417-wide mid vector is ALU-short, not bandwidth-heavy. Register pressure is lower than Q4 unpack.

coalescing.C_layout: row-major f16 [r, n], stage-1 is a standard row-wise GEMV; simd 32 consecutive lanes hit consecutive halves
coalescing.U_layout: row-major f16 [m, r], stage-2 same pattern on a short k=r inner dimension
coalescing.vs_q4: Q4 is 32 code bytes + 2 scale per 64-wide group. f16 factors are simpler loads. Coalescing is not the blocker.

fused_recompute_is_a_trap.why: The shipped fused kernel recomputes mid[rank] in EVERY threadgroup (2176 TGs on gate). At G035 r=417 that is tens of times the dense GEMV FLOPs. It is the right fused shape for rank 160 × n 512 (hgravs01_r160). It is the wrong shape for G035.

6_memory_layout.representation: Pair-shared G035 column basis, f16 factors, no Q4. One U[m,r] per adjacent pair per organ; one C[r,n] per layer per organ. Row-major, 64-byte aligned. No recurrent extra state. mid[r] f32 is workspace, not stored.
6_memory_layout.why_pairs_not_all64: g1-shared-basis falsified a single all-layer basis (shared rank-256 residual 1.08–1.83× per-layer). G035 tested pairs. The layout matches the experiment that already lost, not a more aggressive share that lost harder.
